meta.notes:
## 2026-11-13 re-check (LIVE, headless Chrome via puppeteer, logged out)
Pages: `/` (iPhone UA 390x844 and macOS Safari UA 1280x800), `/in/williamhgates`, `/company/microsoft`, a `/jobs/view/<id>` and `/jobs/search/?keywords=engineer` (iPhone). LIVE counts are total (visible). They replace the curl-only evidence of 2026-11-08, which stays valid.
- **Existing rules still match:** `.contextual-sign-in-modal[data-show-on-page-load]` 1 on profile and company (0 visible while it waits for its script), `.bottom-cta-banner` 1 (1), `.browsemap` 1, `.related-posts` 1, `section.activities` 1, `section.updates` 1, `footer.li-footer` 1, the four home promo blocks 1 each, `[data-id="conversion-prompt"]` 1 (0 visible), `#credential_picker_container` 1 on desktop pages.
- **Public pages now show post cards:** `.social-action-bar` 8 (8) profile, 10 (10) company. `[data-test-id="social-actions__reactions"]` and `...__comments` 28 (15) each on the profile, 10 (10) on the company.
- `.top-card-layout .not-first-middot` 1 (1) on a profile ("41M followers", "8 connections"); a company page has no such element: its followers sit in plain text with the location in `.top-card-layout__first-subline`, which CSS cannot split.
- **Photos:** `.top-card__profile-image-container` 1, `.face-pile__images-container` 11 (5), `.base-main-card__media` 10 (3), `.profile-section-card__image-link` 5 (5) on the profile; `.search-entity-media` 60 (60) and `img.artdeco-entity-image` 60 in job search, 2 on a job. Faces and logos are `div[role=img]` with a background image, so blur hits the container.
- **Jobs:** `.num-applicants__caption` 1 (1) on a job; `.job-posting-benefits` 53 (53) in job search ("Be an early applicant" 40, "Actively Hiring" 12).
- **Sign-in wall fixed:** the dialog that opens on a public profile ("View Bill's full profile") is NOT inside `.contextual-sign-in-modal[data-show-on-page-load]`: it is portaled to the body in `.top-level-modal-container` (1 on profile, company and job pages, 0 on `/`), while the v1 `.modal--contextual-sign-in` inside the attribute wrapper is gone (0 matches). The old rule therefore hid an empty wrapper. New rule `.top-level-modal-container` on the same option; with it hidden the profile renders fully (screenshot: header, photo, About, articles, the Join to view profile and Message buttons).
## SOURCE or INFERRED (signed-in, hand-written fixtures `desktop-feed.html`, `desktop-feed-new.html`)
- Feed posts, top bar badges: LinkedIn Focus extension (`[data-testid="mainFeed"]`, `[data-testid="primary-nav"] span[data-color-scheme]`, `#global-nav .notification-badge`), mig4ng/ublock-origin-filters (`.feed-sort-toggle-dsa__wrapper`, `.premium-upsell-link`, `.msg-overlay-container`), JustZix blog (`.feed-shared-update-v2`).
- `.social-details-social-counts` is from a scraper sample of the feed markup, not seen on a page here.
- Earlier INFERRED, unchanged: feed-aside, messaging-bubble, ad-banners, premium-links. The Hide state of Feed posts also hides the composer if it sits inside `mainFeed`. Hiding all `.feed-shared-update-v2` means the fixture no longer marks an organic post `data-keep`.
## Original check (curl HTML, iPhone UA, 2026-11-08)
`.promo-bottom-sheet` 1 on `/jobs/` only (script shows it). Sign-in modal wrappers for Follow, Connect, Apply lack `data-show-on-page-load` and stay. Suggestions: `.articles-content-card`, `.top-content-categories` (article), `.people-also-viewed`, `.similar-jobs`, `.similar-searches`, `[data-test-id="more-searches"]` (job), affiliated-pages, similar-pages, browse-jobs (company); `.comments__container` and `.article-social-activity` on the article.

How the pop-up and bottom sheet look while shown, scroll lock, the cookie toast template `#toasts` (deliberately left), the signed-in app, routes that answer 999 to curl (`/in/...` does for curl, but loads in Chrome).
